daily.today_energy: Venus sextile Jupiter is basically handing you good vibes on a silver platter. With Saturn retrograde, you're rethinking what actually matters. Trust your gut—it's being unusually sharp today.
daily.love: That Venus-Jupiter sextile? Perfect for deepening connections or finally having the conversation you've been sitting on. Your sensuality is peaked, but keep it real—no performative stuff.
daily.career: Mars conjunct Jupiter in Leo is pushing ambition hard, but Sun square Mars might make you restless. Channel that into starting something, not abandoning what's working. Quality over speed.
daily.health: Mercury in Scorpio wants you digging into what your body actually needs. Good day for meal planning, therapy, or finally booking that appointment you've postponed.

weekly.overview: This week hits different for you, Taurus. The Moon's journey from your sign into Gemini and Leo keeps things moving—Best Day is Wednesday when Moon Trines Mars, giving you serious momentum. Watch out for midweek restlessness as Mars shifts into Virgo, shaking up your usual rhythm. By weekend, Sun Trine Saturn steadies the ship and reminds you that slow wins actually work.
weekly.love: Early week feels cozy as Venus in Libra keeps things balanced and flirty. Midweek Mars Conjunction Jupiter amplifies passion, but don't confuse intensity with clarity—people might be saying more than they mean. By Friday, Mars moves into practical Virgo, shifting dating vibes from spontaneous to deliberate. This suits you just fine.
weekly.career: Mercury in Scorpio keeps your mind sharp and your words cutting. Early week is ideal for difficult conversations or negotiations—you've got the edge. Sun Square Mars midweek might create tension with authority figures, so pick your battles. The Mars shift into Virgo by Friday is your golden ticket: detail work, systems, and execution suddenly feel natural. Use this energy.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for grounding this week—yoga, long walks, or time outside work best. Early-week Moon Trine Mars gives you physical confidence; use it for workouts or movement you've been postponing. Midweek might bring scattered energy as Mars transitions. By weekend, lean into rest and routine. Saturn's influence reminds you: consistency beats intensity every time.
